video_title: Perk Tells Sabonis to ADJUST to Darius Acuff’s Kings

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Domantas Sabonis must adjust to being the face of the Kings
quotes.excerpt: This is Darius Acuff's vehicle. This is his franchise. They have officially handed him the keys.
quotes.quote: It is not on Darius Acuff to adjust to you, bro. This is Darius Acuff's vehicle. This is his franchise. They have officially handed him the keys. He is the face. You are not anymore. I get it, you are not used to playing with a guy like Darius Acuff. It took a lot of people to be able to adjust to playing with Steph Curry off the top. It took Steph Curry to have to adjust and say, you know what, I have to let Steph be Steph. And there is Darius Acuff, he showed us who he was in college and he is showing us who he is right now.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. is the new cornerstone for the Sacramento Kings
quotes.excerpt: Now they got that real dirt. Now they starting to have the concrete, and that's Darius Acuff Jr.
quotes.quote: I have been hearing a lot of comps like he is the new Ray Allen. Yes, he is one of those guys that is going to put up a lot of shots, but he is also going to bust your ass. At the end of the day, the Sacramento Kings has been the laughingstock of the NBA for so long. Now they got that real dirt. Now they starting to have the concrete, and that's Darius Acuff Jr. And I am going to say this, he should have been the top guard drafted. Seriously. I got called everything but a child of God when I was reminding the world who this man is. The only problem is he is going to struggle to get wins, that is okay, but the numbers are going to be there.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Domantas Sabonis is not a championship-level go-to player in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: Sabonis has never shown you that the way that if he's your main go-to guy, you are going to go far
quotes.quote: From strictly a basketball point of view, because I think Sabonis is a great human being, so don't jump on me if you are a Sabonis fan, Sabonis has never shown you that the way that if he is your main go-to guy, you are going to go far in the playoffs. Sabonis is not a matchup issue versus anyone in the Western Conference anymore. He has been hurt, he is undersized, defensively they go at him in the playoffs. When you get a new regime to come in, they go, what do you need to win playoff games? You need a bucket getter. What is Damian Lillard? What is Luka Doncic? What is Devin Booker? What is Jamal Murray? What is Shai Gilgeous-Alexander? You need a bucket getter. You do not need a mid-sized four-man that is okay from the three-point line.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: The Kings should prioritize acquiring players who elevate their program
quotes.excerpt: We will give up valuable assets to bring him in because he is going to elevate our program.
quotes.quote: You can say you want out, but right now, if you look around the league, what teams actually will say, give me Sabonis on this salary? He is going to take us over the top. We will give up valuable assets to bring him in because he is going to elevate our program. Seriously, what team?

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Kings need to maximize their investment in their star player
quotes.excerpt: You are making 45 million? Now brother, you better get it right in Sacramento.
quotes.quote: You are making 45 million? Now brother, you better get it right in Sacramento. You can want out, but it takes two to tangle. Who wants it?
